   * High-growth accounts (`@dhavalkataria_` at 18.14% and `@favourite.engineer` at 7.72%) capture mass reach using visceral 3-second visual hooks (e.g., UI screen recordings, high-utility tool comparisons, relatable tech humor). `@garvit.irl` currently over-indexes on transactional "comment X to get Y" prompts, which restricts organic viral sharing.

   * Despite an industry-leading **36.24% engagement rate**, `@garvit.irl` sits at **5,961 followers**. Competitors with lower relative engagement convert viewers into followers at scale by positioning their profiles as comprehensive resource hubs rather than single-post lead-generation points.
